elements.summary: Stack Fire Attack and burn the head during every down. Ink of Flames carries the raw while Ruger Aidal keeps element buildup rolling.

visageSet.name: Ink of Flames
visageSet.bonus: Fire Attack +3 and +15% Fire damage while Well-Fed.

coreVisages.name: Ruger Aidal
coreVisages.effect: Element damage +10% and faster elemental buildup.

coreVisages.name: Radiant Rathian
coreVisages.effect: Critical Element +12% while at full health.

buddies.name: Kojiro
buddies.skill: Blazing Fang - tandem attack with heavy Fire buildup.

buddies.name: Pipa
buddies.skill: Warm Canteen - heals and refreshes Well-Fed.

weapons.name: Cinderblast Apex
weapons.forgePath: Forge from Iron Assault at the Smithy after clearing the 6-star Fire hunt. Upgrade path: Iron Assault -> Cinderblast Apex.
weapons.insight: Open with a trap or mount, then dump your highest Fire combo while the burn tick is active. Aim for the head from mid range and reload behind cover.
